EP10:E19 20000-23000 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.
EP10:E20 20900-22900 JULIANA [Gentle, Insistent]: "I need to see the wound."
EP10:E21 23000-25200 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.
EP10:E22 23200-24900 ALEXANDER [Low, Defiant]: "It is only a scratch."
EP10:E23 25200-28000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.
EP10:E24 25500-28000 JULIANA [Sarcastic, Challenging]: "Then removing your shirt should not trouble you."
EP10:E25 28000-31800 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.
EP10:E26 31800-33200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.
EP10:E27 33200-36500 CAMERA: Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
EP10:E28 36500-38000 CAMERA: Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
EP10:E29 38000-39200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.
EP10:E30 38100-38900 JULIANA [Whispering, Distressed]: "Dear God."
EP10:E31 39200-43000 CAMERA: Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.
EP10:E32 43000-45000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.
EP10:E33 45000-47300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.
EP10:E34 45300-47100 JULIANA [Soft, Sorrowful]: "You have suffered terribly."
EP10:E35 47300-49500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.
EP10:E36 47800-49000 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Somber]: "It is over."
EP10:E37 49500-51500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.
EP10:E38 49700-51300 JULIANA [Gentle]: "Your scars disagree."
EP10:E39 51500-54000 CAMERA: Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.
EP10:E40 52000-53300 JULIANA [Tender]: "Does it hurt?"
EP10:E41 54000-55500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander trying not to wince under her touch.
EP10:E42 54000-55200 ALEXANDER [Gruff]: "Not much."
EP10:E43 55500-58000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, amused by his stubborn pride.
EP10:E44 55600-57600 JULIANA [Playful, Whispering]: "You are a terrible liar."
EP10:E45 58000-60000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's fingers taking a dollop of green herbal salve and smoothing it gently over his shoulder wound.
EP10:E46 60000-63000 CAMERA: Close-up over Juliana's shoulder looking at Alexander, who stares intently into her face, oblivious to the wound.
EP10:E47 63000-66200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up from his shoulder into his eyes, sensing the intensity of his gaze.
EP10:E48 63900-66100 JULIANA [Soft, Breathless]: "Why do you look at me like that?"
EP10:E49 66200-68800 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his voice deep and laden with restrained emotion.
EP10:E50 66500-68400 ALEXANDER [Intense, Sincere]: "Because you are looking at me."
EP10:E51 68800-71500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back down at his shoulder to hide her growing fluster, applying the salve carefully.
EP10:E52 69600-70900 JULIANA [Flustered, Whispering]: "Hold still."
EP10:E53 71500-74500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander leaning closer to her, his breathing heavy.
EP10:E54 72100-74200 ALEXANDER [Low, Husky]: "I am holding still."
EP10:E55 74500-77000 CAMERA: Close-up two-shot of their faces drawing mere inches apart in the warm firelight.
EP10:E56 76800-79000 ALEXANDER [Whispering, Vulnerable]: "Perhaps it is your hand."
EP10:E57 79000-82500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hands reaching up and gently enveloping Juliana's slender hands, bringing them against his bare chest over his racing heart.
EP10:E58 82500-86500 CAMERA: Close-up shot of Alexander gazing into Juliana's eyes with raw, unmasked devotion.
EP10:E59 82600-85900 ALEXANDER [Deep, Emotional]: "Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain."
EP10:E60 86500-94000 CAMERA: Close-up shot holding on Juliana's wide, luminous blue eyes, completely captivated and overwhelmed by his confession, the firelight dancing across their intertwined hands as the scene lingers and fades.

opportunities.concept: A bloodied Alexander bursts into the cottage and forces his way into a confrontation with Juliana, who refuses to accept his claim that it is only a scratch.
opportunities.why_promising: The clip opens on a sudden door-bang and a bloodied figure in the doorway, then builds a standoff over his injuries that ends on Juliana's unanswered challenge to remove his shirt, leaving the reveal unresolved.

opportunities.concept: Alexander removes his shirt to reveal battle scars and fresh lacerations, and Juliana's horrified reaction is followed by a dismissive claim that the wound does not hurt.
opportunities.why_promising: The shirt reveal of scars and bleeding wounds is a strong visual hook, and the clip ends on his unconvincing 'Not much', leaving his injuries and past unexplained.

opportunities.concept: Juliana tends Alexander's shoulder, and his intense gaze turns the moment into a charged, unspoken attraction that she questions aloud.
opportunities.why_promising: The clip opens on Juliana asking why he looks at her that way and builds toward his open declaration, ending on her overwhelmed reaction with her feelings still unresolved.

opportunities.concept: Juliana sees blood running down Alexander's arm and calls out his lie, and the clip moves through his denials to his quiet 'It is over' over the wounds.
